run_validation: run fairseq model validation on a dataset subset using checkpoint and config args
run_validation_cli: run the fairseq validate CLI to evaluate a model checkpoint on validation data
load_model_ensemble: load a fairseq model ensemble and task from a checkpoint path with overrides
build_criterion: build a criterion object from the task config for computing validation loss
reduce_metrics: reduce and aggregate validation log outputs across distributed workers to compute final metrics
